lines.after: - **Per-component checklist (app projects):** `_Templates/_Component Security Checklist.md`, installed where the project shows a UI, with `--with-templates web`, or where a copy is already in place, completed BEFORE a component is complete. Why: security reviewed last is security bolted on.

lines.before: **Triggers:** (1) **before any substantive PR to `main`** (new behaviour or surface, security / privacy / legal relevance, a sub-project; when unsure, swarm) - a sweep at its tier (rule:sweep-tiers), the Pre-PR Deep Sweep for a feature; a chore / docs / one-line PR gets the triage tier; (2) **mid-build** when an arc adds a runtime dependency or external data flow; (3) a **launch-gate sweep** of EVERY surface before any public major version.
lines.after: **Triggers:** (1) **before any substantive PR to `main`**, and when its feature is done before anything else on it (new behaviour or surface, security / privacy / legal relevance, a sub-project; when unsure, swarm; the one exception is the build's draft PR, opened after its first commit so main's checks run early, which stays a draft until the sweep) - a sweep at its tier (rule:sweep-tiers), the Pre-PR Deep Sweep for a feature; a chore / docs / one-line PR gets the triage tier; (2) **mid-build** when an arc adds a runtime dependency or external data flow; (3) a **launch-gate sweep** of EVERY surface before any public major version.
